title: Flint and Alba Save the Light
markdown:
Here's what they don't tell you in the books: grand adventures start with a wobbly light! I remember the Great Lantern of Port Blossom, its steady golden eye usually watching over Mariner's Bay. But one foggy evening, it blinked all wrong! Thick mist swallowed the horizon. Ships were in grave danger!

"The pattern is broken!" squawked Alba, a lighthouse gull with pearl-like feathers. "The ships will be lost!"

Suddenly, Flint the ferret popped out, whiskers twitching. "Lost? Not on my watch! What's amiss, Alba?"

"The turning part is jammed!" Alba cried. "To the watchtower! Now!"

The path up was a dragon's spine of rock. Alba soared ahead. Flint scrambled, a blur of sandy fur, his sharp claws finding tiny holds. The wind howled. Alba’s sharp eyes pierced the mist, guiding Flint.

"I see the opening!" Alba called.

In a flash, Flint darted into the lamp room. The Great Lantern pulsed weakly. A stone, as big as Flint's head, was wedged in the gears!

"That's it!" Flint yipped. "Alba! Your beak, quick!"

Flint nudged with all his might. Alba pushed with her strong beak. A thrilling, shaky battle against the stubborn stone!

Then, with a mighty screech, the stone tumbled free!

The Great Lantern roared back to life, its beam a golden sword slicing through the fog. Blink, blink, blink—a steady rhythm. A beacon of hope.

"They'll be safe," Alba breathed.

Flint puffed out his chest. "We did it! My paws and your beak—a winning combination!"

The fog receded like a shy curtain. Ships sailed safely into the harbor. Flint and Alba, the unlikely heroes, were the true guardians of Mariner's Bay. Incredible. Absolutely incredible.
characters: Flint the ferret, Alba the lighthouse gull
